steps.description: Pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples), median-of-ratios size factors, design ~ batch + condition with explicit reference levels, Wald test on condition coefficient, apeglm shrinkage, BH with independent filtering at alpha 0.05.
acceptance_criteria: results table with baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, shrunken LFC (apeglm), stat, pvalue, padj
Number of genes with NA p-value from Cook's-distance outlier flagging reported separately (6 per condition is below the 7-replicate replacement threshold)
p-value histogram shown and its shape described before trusting padj
padj < 0.05 gene counts (up and down) reported
Unmapped/multi-mapped symbol issues not applicable; report tested-gene count after filters

steps.name: edgeR QL robustness cross-check
caveats: Disagreement grows at low counts and low replicates; report both directions
steps.context: Same counts.csv and metadata; edgeR 4.10.3 is installed
steps.question: Do the same genes come out significant under edgeR quasi-likelihood?

grounding.reason: edgeR QL as the second method at 2-11 replicates per group; overlap as robustness per R-0042@54e1

steps.description: Independent edgeR run on the same counts and same design (~batch + condition): TMM factors, glmQLFit, glmQLFTest on the condition coefficient, BH FDR. Report per-method significant counts and the intersection as the high-confidence set.
acceptance_criteria: edgeR QL result table with FDR
Counts of significant genes from each method and size of their intersection reported
Intersection written as the high-confidence set; single-method genes listed as method-specific
Union NOT presented as the result

steps.name: Report and reproducibility record
steps.question: What is the final, reproducible answer to which genes differ between treated and control?

grounding.reason: Report fields, diagnostics, dual LFC reporting and method overlap per R-0041/R-0085/R-0087/R-0042

steps.description: Final report: method/versions/design/thresholds/n_tested/n_DE, MA and dispersion plots, p-value histogram, top-gene table (unshrunken LFC + apeglm-shrunken LFC + lfcSE, ranked by shrunken LFC), DESeq2-vs-edgeR overlap table, sessionInfo and seed.
acceptance_criteria: Report names method, package versions, design formula, contrast direction, thresholds, n_tested, n_DE per method and intersection
MA plot and dispersion plot included before gene tables
Gene table carries unshrunken LFC, shrunken LFC, lfcSE; ranking and plots on the shrunken value; p-values from the unshrunken fit
sessionInfo, seed, and gene-level-counts deviation (no tximport) recorded

plan.title: Treated vs control kidney DE with batch covariate
plan.analytical_narrative: 12 human kidney bulk RNA-seq samples (6 treated vs 6 control) in two processing batches balanced across conditions. Batch is handled as a fixed design term (~ batch + condition), not by pre-correcting counts. Gene-level raw counts (12,000 genes x 12 samples, symbols) are already provided, so no tximport/length-offset import is possible or needed; the plan notes this deviation. Pipeline: blind vst sample-structure QC (PCA, distances, library sizes) -> minimal low-count pre-filter -> DESeq2 median-of-ratios size factors, Wald test on the condition coefficient with apeglm shrinkage and BH at alpha 0.05 -> edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the same design as a robustness cross-check (intersection = high-confidence set) -> report with MA and dispersion diagnostics, p-value histogram, both shrunken and unshrunken LFCs, method overlap, and reproducibility record.
